items.title: Shipping forecast updated as of 24 July 2026 11:39pm
items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Friday, 24 July 2026 at 11:30pm by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Strong winds.


##Synopsis##

Ridge of high pressure is displaced from the northwest by an approaching frontal system tomorrow.


##Wind##

West or Southwest 4 or 5, increasing 5 or 6 later tonight or at first tomorrow morning, then veering and decreasing West or Northwest 3 or 4 in afternoon in most waters, but still 5 or 6 in the southeast of the area. Becoming West or Northwest 3 or 4 in all waters in evening.


##State of Sea##

Slight or moderate.


##Weather##

Patchy rain.


##Visibility##

Good, possibly moderate in rain.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

West or Northwest 3 or 4, increasing West 5 or 6 later tomorrow night. Veering West or Northwest 5 or 6 on Sunday morning, then decreasing 4 or 5 later in day or overnight into Monday..


##State of Sea##

Slight or moderate.


##Weather##

Patchy rain and drizzle, then isolated showers.


##Visibility##

Good, possibly moderate or poor in precipitation.
